domains.title: Domains, websites or work emails
domains.description: One per line, e.g. stripe.com, https://www.notion.so/product, jane@acme.com. Paths, www and the part before @ are stripped.

maxPagesPerSite.title: Max pages per site
maxPagesPerSite.description: Homepage plus about, contact, impressum and team pages found on it. More pages find more emails and phones but take longer.

includeTechStack.title: Tech stack
includeTechStack.description: Detect CMS, ecommerce platform, analytics, marketing, payments and hosting from the homepage.

includeDnsInsights.title: DNS insights
includeDnsInsights.description: Email provider from MX, SaaS tools from SPF and verification TXT records, DMARC policy.

includeDomainAge.title: Domain age and registrar
includeDomainAge.description: Registration date, expiry and registrar from RDAP.

maxRows.title: Max companies per run
maxRows.description: Cap on domains enriched. Controls cost.
